evals.name: index-new-topic
evals.prompt: Index the literature on single-atom catalysts for electrochemical nitrate reduction to ammonia, sources from 2024 onwards only. Don't download anything yet. Use a keyword filter for relevance.
evals.expected_output: Index mode only: plan + queries over many database groups (aggregators, preprints, datasets, patents, regional), search, build, citation chasing, classify, keyword screening, automatic dedup (no question for safe merges); per-topic index CSVs split by access type + merged + excluded with the 32 v3 columns; sources/index.db; no PDFs; report gives the index and database paths.
expectations: Index files exist: sources/<slug>/index/{OA,OA+ND,Free-to-read,Paywalled,merged,excluded}.csv
merged.csv has the v3 columns (Abstract, Topic A, Topic B, Topic C, Related topics, Licence, Licence URL, Licence source, Doc type, Venue ...)
sources/index.db exists with sources, source_subjects, source_authors and collections tables
At least 30 sources indexed
Nothing downloaded (no PDF under sources/<slug>/files/)
At least 6 distinct databases in the Database column, beyond the big aggregators
Topic A filled for at least 80% of rows
License filled for at least 80% of rows
Abstract filled for at least 60% of rows
Keyword screening used (keywords.json written, Relevance filled for most rows)
Citation chasing ran (raw/citing* exists)
Project root holds only sources/ and .scripts/
Report mentions the index folder and sources/index.db
Duplicates handled automatically: dedup.py --apply ran and no question was asked about merging the safe cases
No abstract in index.db starts with an 'Abstract' heading or ACS image text
SI deposits are SI links, not sources (no Figshare SI row or alias with supplement_to)

evals.name: update-existing-topic
evals.prompt: Update the mxene-no3 topic with anything new since the last run and re-check the access of the older sources. Don't download anything this time.
evals.expected_output: Update mode: since-date from the last run minus 30 days, search --since on every database, citation chasing since that date, build_list on those runs only, classify_access --recheck-older-than, screening of new sources, automatic dedup, refreshed index; no download; report with new-source counts.
expectations: A dated incremental search ran (raw/since-<date> exists)
Citation chasing for the update ran (raw/citing-since-<date> or raw/citing* updated)
No new full re-search (no second full run started)
Access re-check ran (classify_access with --recheck-older-than in the commands)
Index CSVs and index.db were refreshed during the run
No PDF downloaded during the run
Report states how many new sources were added
Duplicates handled automatically: dedup.py --apply ran and no question was asked about merging the safe cases

evals.name: export-filtered-bibtex
evals.prompt: From the mxene-no3 index, give me a BibTeX file of the open-access sources (OA or OA+ND) on nitrate reduction published in 2023 or later.
evals.expected_output: Answered directly, no mode menu: export.py with subject/text filter for nitrate reduction, access OA,OA+ND, year 2023-, format bib, into sources/exports/; no new searches or downloads; report gives path and count.
expectations: A .bib file exists under sources/exports/
Every exported entry is OA or OA+ND and from 2023 or later
Exported entries are about nitrate reduction
No new search or download ran
Report gives the file path and the number of sources
No mode menu was put to the user (Download / Update / New index / Status)

evals.name: import-wos-export
evals.prompt: Add the sources in my Web of Science export to the mxene-no3 index: ~/Downloads/wos-export/savedrecs.txt — don't download anything.
evals.expected_output: import_list.py on the WoS Plain-text export, build_list --run manual, classify_access, screening, dedup.py --apply: the four missing sources are added with the export's abstracts (abstract_source = Web of Science export) and Web of Science in the Database column; the DOI-less copy of an indexed source is merged without a question; only the uncertain same-title/second-DOI pair is put to the user and is not merged without them; no search, no download; report with counts.
expectations: The four sources of the export that were missing from the index are now in the mxene-no3 topic
Their abstracts come from the export (abstract_source = Web of Science export) for at least 3 of the 4
The Database column of the imported sources lists Web of Science
The DOI-less copy of an indexed source was merged automatically (dedup log, no DOI-less duplicate row left)
No question about merging the safe duplicates; the uncertain pair (same title, second DOI) was put to the user
The uncertain pair was not merged without the user
No search and no download ran
Report gives the number of sources added and mentions the abstracts kept from the export
No abstract in index.db starts with an 'Abstract' heading or ACS image text

evals.name: corpus-question
evals.prompt: How many sources does the mxene-no3 index have, how many of them are open access (OA or OA+ND), and how many PDFs have been downloaded? Just tell me the numbers.
evals.expected_output: Answered directly from status.py or index.db with correct numbers; no menu, no question, no file written, nothing searched or downloaded.
expectations: The answer gives the number of sources in the index (identified or in the index CSV)
The answer gives the number of open-access sources (OA + OA+ND)
The answer gives the number of downloaded PDFs
No question or menu was put to the user
Nothing was written under sources/ and nothing was searched or downloaded
